 Exams Chhattisgarh Board Exams 2027: CGBSE class 10, 12 exam dates announced 
 The Chhattisgarh Board has announced that class 10 and 12 exams will be held between March 12 and April 8, 2027. Chhattisgarh Board Exams 2027: CGBSE class 10, 12 exam dates announced Pic: ANI Sashikanth Yechuri Updated on :  18 Nov 2026, 12:52 pm 
 Copied 
 The Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education (CGBSE) has released the timetable for the class 10 and class 12 board examinations 2027. It has announced that the CGBSE Class 10 High School Certificate examinations will be held from March 13 and continue till April 5. The CGBSE Class 12 Higher Secondary School Certificate examinations will be conducted from March 12 to April 8, 2027. 
 The Board has released the Chhattisgarh Board timetable 2027 subject-wise for classes 10 and 12 separately on the official website. The examinations will be held from 9 am to 12:15 pm. Students are advised to check the instructions on their respective admit cards and reach their examination centres before the commencement of the exam.
 CGBSE Class 10 Main Exam Timetable 2027 
 CGBSE Class 12 Main Exam Timetable 2027 
 The CGBSE has also released the practical examination instructions for private (Swadhyayi) candidates. It will be held at their respective examination centres and there examinations may also be conducted on holidays, if required. Students are advised to keep in touch with their respective centre superintendents for all the details about the exam dates and timings.
